name: Family Reunification Residence

requirements.blocker_text: Foreign residents' close relatives (spouses and children) can join them in Burkina Faso through a separate family-reunification visa pathway, typically available a number of months after the sponsor's own initial residence is established. Requirements include proof of relationship, financial capacity, and medical certificates.
requirements.fix_path: As the spouse or child of a lawfully resident foreigner, apply for a family-reunification visa with proof of relationship and financial capacity.

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate or proof of filiation

sources.title: Openshores (private immigration-guide site) -- family reunification pathway for relatives of foreign residents
